_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Bo ta Hungador {player_id} den Three-Player Tic Tac Toe.
Bo símbolo ta '{symbol}'.
Bo ta tuma turno poné bo símbolo ariba un tablero di 5x5 pa forma un lìnea di kuater.
Lìneanan por ta horizontal, vertical, òf diagonal.
Manda bo movimentu usando e formato '[4]' pa marka sel 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid move format. Use '[cell]' where cell is 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Number di cel no ta valido: {cell}. E number mester ta entre 0 i {max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: E hungadó {player_id} a hasi un move inválido.

game_action.placed: Hungador {player_id} poné su símbolo ({symbol}) den kampu ({row}, {col}).
